answer: To suppress Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce verifiable proof of burn, requiring identities to destroy native tokens at a provably unspendable onyx address. An adversary incurs the unrecoverable cost of incinerating liquid capital per identity rather than retaining a reusable ember of collateral. However, permanent burns exclude capital-poor honest agents, while deep-pocketed cartels can still ignite a dense nebula of identities to capture transient voting quorums.
